zh: 新增「附近」：查看身边的美食、景点、咖啡和购物，可打车前往、用高德地图导航或出示中文地址。
底部改为「聊天 / 行程 / 工具 / 我的」。「我的」里有我的记忆、个人信息、设置与账号、帮助与反馈，以及会员方案预览。
打车：车型显示英文名，价格带「¥」和区间。点「在滴滴打开」会直接进入滴滴并带上起点和终点；没装滴滴时打开 App Store。
打车搜索太频繁、次数用完或选了港澳台城市时，提示更清楚。
en: New Nearby tool: find food, sights, coffee and shopping around you, then take a taxi, get directions in AMap or show the address in Chinese.
The tabs are now Chat, Trips, Tools and Me. Me has your memory, profile, settings and account, help, and a preview of plans.
Taxi: ride options have English names and prices show yuan and ranges. Open in DiDi now opens DiDi with your pickup and destination, or the App Store if DiDi isn't installed.
Clearer messages when you search too often, reach the limit or choose a city outside mainland China.

zh: 构建 55 接续构建 54。语言、外观、注销账号和退出登录从聊天菜单移到「我的」；「记忆」Tab 并入「我的」。修复切到后台再回来时，聊天里出现「暂时无法显示你的选择」。
en: Build 55 follows build 54. Language, appearance, account deletion and sign out moved from the chat menu to Me, and Memory is now inside Me. Fixed "Couldn’t show your saved choice" appearing in chat after returning to the app.

zh: 用默认字号测中英界面：在「我的」查看我的记忆、会员方案和设置，切换语言。
打车：英文界面看车型英文名和价格；点「在滴滴打开」，已装滴滴应直接进入滴滴并带上起终点，只走到确认页，请勿下单；没装滴滴应打开 App Store。
附近：允许定位后切换分类、范围和排序，打开一个地点试打车、导航和出示地址。在聊天里问一个行程问题后把 App 切到后台再回来，确认不再出现「暂时无法显示你的选择」。
遇到问题，请在内部测试群发截图、问题记录及发生时间。
en: At the default text size, check both languages: open your memory, the plans preview and settings in Me, and switch language.

Taxi: in English, check ride option names and prices. Tap Open in DiDi: with DiDi installed it should open DiDi with your pickup and destination (stop at vehicle confirmation without ordering); without DiDi it should open the App Store.

Nearby: allow location, switch categories, distance and order, then open a place and try taxi, directions and the Chinese address. Ask Lio about a trip, leave the app and come back, and check that "Couldn’t show your saved choice" no longer appears.
Share a screenshot, the copied issue record and the time it happened in the internal testing group.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 会员方案只是预览，不能购买，也不会扣费。个人信息暂时只能查看。
按天展示的结构化行程和可交互地铁图放在下一版。支付宝里的滴滴暂不能一键打开。
酒店、千问朗读、天气、航班、上网卡、玩乐暂未开放。本地协助暂不发送求助消息。
en: Plans are a preview only: nothing can be bought or charged. Profile is view-only for now.
Day-by-day trip plans and the interactive metro map come in a later build. DiDi in Alipay can't be opened directly yet.
Hotels, Qwen voice playback, Weather, Flights, eSIM and Activities are unavailable. Local Support does not send help requests.

zh: 附近和打车地点搜索需要联网，供已开通的内测账号使用。地点来自滴滴和高德。
滴滴决定实际价格。打车只在滴滴继续。
en: Nearby and taxi place search require internet access and an enabled tester account. Places come from DiDi and AMap.
DiDi sets the final price and handles the ride.

zh: 「插件」改名为「工具」，首页改成双列卡片，每个工具都有图标和一句话说明。
翻译合成一个页面：上方显示译文，下方是输入栏。按住麦克风说话，松开即翻译；点相机可拍照或从相册选图。
打车的起点和终点可以直接搜索地点名称，先选城市再搜；没有结果时会提示换个叫法或核对城市。打车和本地协助页面按新版界面重新排版。
地铁指南改为先选城市，再看乘车步骤和官方线路图。
本地协助的「给当地人看」新增医疗卡：血型、过敏、用药和紧急联系人只保存在这台手机上，可全屏给医生看，也可随时一键清空。
en: Plugins is now called Tools, with a two-column card for each tool showing an icon and one line about it.
Translation is one page: the translation on top and an input bar below. Hold the microphone to talk and release to translate; tap the camera to take a photo or choose one.
Search for taxi pickup and destination places by name after choosing a city. If nothing is found, you get a tip to try another name or check the city. Taxi and Local Support have a new layout.
The Metro Guide now starts by choosing a city, then shows riding steps and official maps.
Show a Local in Local Support now has a medical card: blood type, allergies, medicines and emergency contacts stay only on this phone, can be shown full screen to a doctor and cleared at any time.

zh: 构建 54 接续构建 53。翻译去掉了文字、语音、拍照三种模式切换。
en: Build 54 follows build 53. Translation no longer switches between text, voice and photo modes.

zh: 用默认字号测中英界面：工具首页卡片，以及翻译页的打字、按住说话、拍照和从相册选图。
打车：在北京、上海、成都各搜 3 个常见地点（如天安门、外滩、宽窄巷子），确认能生成滴滴链接。只走到滴滴确认页，请勿下单。
地铁指南：先选城市再看乘车步骤，打开官方线路图链接。打车和本地协助：核对新版界面的中英显示。
遇到问题，请在内部测试群发截图、问题记录及发生时间。
en: At the default text size, check both languages: the Tools cards, and typing, holding to talk, taking a photo and choosing a photo in Translation.
Taxi: search 3 common places each in Beijing, Shanghai and Chengdu (for example Tiananmen, the Bund, Kuanzhai Alley) and check that a DiDi link opens. Stop at vehicle confirmation without ordering.
Metro Guide: choose a city, view the riding steps and open an official map link. Taxi and Local Support: check the new layout in both languages.
Share a screenshot, the copied issue record and the time it happened in the internal testing group.

title.en: Known issues and checks to avoid
title.zh: 已知问题和暂不测试内容

zh: 可缩放的交互式地铁图还在等待授权，本版只有城市选择、乘车步骤和官方线路图链接。
附近、酒店、千问朗读、天气、航班、上网卡、玩乐暂未开放。本地协助暂不发送求助消息。
en: The zoomable metro map is waiting for approval. This build has city choice, riding steps and links to official maps.
Nearby, Hotels, Qwen voice playback, Weather, Flights, eSIM and Activities are unavailable. Local Support does not send help requests.

zh: 打车地点搜索需要联网，供已开通的内测账号使用。地点来自滴滴和高德。
滴滴决定实际价格。打车只在滴滴继续。
en: Taxi place search requires internet access and an enabled tester account. Places come from DiDi and AMap.
DiDi sets the final price and handles the ride.
